open_points.text: - issue_contract_version: [VALIDATION_ERROR] The release ceilings are the imported RELEASE_CEILING_WALL_TIME_MS, RELEASE_CEILING_MEMORY_BYTES, RELEASE_CEILING_OUTPUT_BYTES and RELEASE_CEILING_PROCESS_COUNT constants for the fields of the same name; a bound above its ceiling or omitted is refused, never clamped or defaulted; every check after the purpose rule binds only a new version: contract_version_id is computed right after the purpose rule, and an existing equal contract version is returned unchanged even when a later release lowered a ceiling below its bounds (A01 rule 4, A20 rule 4).
